company.shortDescription: Prezi is an interactive cloud-based presentation platform that helps users connect with their audience.
company.description:
Prezi is an interactive cloud-based presentation platform that helps users connect with their audience. Prezi's latest offering, Prezi Next, is a full-lifecycle presentation platform so everyone can easily create visually stunning presentations, deliver them in a more natural and conversational way, and analyze their effectiveness.

It was founded in 2008 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Real time video feed presentation enhancement system describes a system to enhance a live video feed in real time. A live video feed captured by a video capturing device is received and its presentation on client devices is enhanced by inserting and managing multiple content items. This indicates development of interactive, cloud mediated video presentation experiences and dynamic content overlays to improve audience engagement in live presentations and real time communication.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Private Equity round raised $57,000,000, or 78.34% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,457,036 to $313,757,775, a 127.7x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
